description: Platform accounts only: creates a test customer (sub-tenant legal entity) in the getpeppr sandbox and returns its registration state. Up to 10 active test customers per account; identifier rules per country: https://getpeppr.dev/docs/platform/legal-entities/. Calling it again with the same arguments returns the same test customer with its current status, never a second one. Pass the returned legalEntity.id as sender.legalEntityId to send_test_invoice once its status allows sending. Requires the admin role and signing in to getpeppr.

companyName.description: The test customer company's legal name.

externalId.description: Your own id for this customer company. Calling again with the same arguments returns the same test customer, with its current status.

identifiers.description: Several identifiers, in the order the country guide gives.

name: create_test_customer
title: Create a sandbox test customer
